$comment: §7.1/Appendix P — the PlayCall payload: Maxwell's ladder of plays. Canonical bytes ≤ MaxCallBytes (4096); ≤ 16 entries, ≤ 4 overlay entries (MaxActiveOverlays). Validation is loud and total before anything takes effect (§7.1). Included here for completeness of the wire contract; its validator is P3 (lane C) work.
title: ladder_call

play.$comment: a seat-bound module name, or a reserved engine-native reflex name (reflex_clear_grenade / reflex_clear_spray / reflex_zone_escape, parameterless)

entry_id.$comment: stable id, unique within the call; defaulted from play name and position when omitted

when.$comment: guard: the engine's closed JSON s-expression form over registered view/context paths; depth ≤ 4, nodes ≤ 64, no non-finite literals; a guardless controller always passes

params.$comment: validated against the play's manifest ParamSpec schema; unknown keys rejected by name with the parameter path

retune.$comment: omit when false; §7.2's adoption table governs matching against the outgoing ladder
